title: Online Tool for Construction Cost Estimations
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-NJ.W6QK ACC-PICA
detail_text: The U.S. Army Contracting Command ? New Jersey, on behalf of U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command - Armaments Center (DEVCOM-AC) is issuing this sources sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties capable of providing a commercial software solution for construction cost estimation. The intention is to procure on a competitive basis. See Attachment.
